finding-7aeee916077462b4.confidenceReason: Medium confidence because the scanner heuristic identifies a pattern that may still be vulnerable even with escapeHtml.
finding-7aeee916077462b4.evidenceSummary:
Hermsec heuristic scanner found res.send(`

${escapeHtml(String(req.query.name ?? ""))}

`); at src/app.js:7, but escapeHtml is used; however the finding suggests it may still be risky. Confidence is medium.
finding-7aeee916077462b4.impact: Cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability via unsanitized user input in HTML response at src/app.js:7, potentially allowing attacker to inject scripts.
safeNextSteps: Review the use of escapeHtml to ensure it is properly escaping all contexts
Consider using a templating engine that auto-escapes
Conduct manual code review of the response construction
finding-7aeee916077462b4.suggestedFix: Escape untrusted output before placing it in HTML responses.
finding-7aeee916077462b4.title: HTML response may include unsanitized input

finding-b1bdc12ef0d825ab.confidenceReason: Medium confidence because the scanner heuristic identifies a pattern where variables are directly interpolated without escaping.
finding-b1bdc12ef0d825ab.evidenceSummary:
Hermsec heuristic scanner found res.send(`

${name}

${digest}

`); at src/routes/search.js:34 with no escaping applied.
finding-b1bdc12ef0d825ab.impact: Cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability via unsanitized user input in HTML response at src/routes/search.js:34, potentially allowing attacker to inject scripts.
safeNextSteps: Apply HTML escaping to all interpolated variables
Consider using a templating engine with auto-escaping
finding-b1bdc12ef0d825ab.suggestedFix: Escape untrusted output before placing it in HTML responses.
finding-b1bdc12ef0d825ab.title: HTML response may include unsanitized input
